title: MindLoom: Composing Thought Modes for Frontier-Level Reasoning Data Synthesis
authors_zh: Haiyang Shen, Taian Guo, Xuanzhong Chen, Mugeng Liu, Weichen Bi, Wenchun Jing, Sixiong Xie, Zhuofan Shi, Yudong Han, Chongyang Pan, Siqi Zhong, Jinsheng Huang, Ming Zhang, Yun Ma
paper_type_zh: 组合式推理数据合成方法与数据集
best_for_zh: 适合用可复用推理变换生成 STEM SFT 数据的研究者。
one_line: MindLoom extracts reusable thought modes from verified solutions, composes them under compatibility and scarcity control, and keeps 9,230 judged-correct SFT records.
MindLoom 从已验证解答中提取可复用 thought mode，在兼容性与稀缺度控制下组合新题，并保留 9,230 条判定正确的 SFT 记录。
why: It makes reasoning-data composition auditable through mode tuples, retrieval scores, provenance filters, and rollout decisions.
inclusion_reason: Exposes thought modes as reusable data-construction objects and releases a provenance-filtered SFT conversion pipeline.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning-data generators can mutate wording or whole solutions, but they have little visibility into which atomic transformations make a problem difficult. This leads to narrow reasoning coverage, repeated patterns, and unstable control over frontier-level difficulty.

MindLoom reverse-engineers verified solutions into reusable thought modes, learns which modes fit a problem state, composes scarce compatible modes into new questions, and keeps judged-correct solution rollouts. The output is a provenance-filtered SFT set whose construction units are explicit reasoning transformations.

L4 facts: official source arXiv:2605.21630, 2026; arXiv preprint with no confirmed venue; decision boundary is a provenance-safe synthesized problem with at least one judged-correct rollout; Track-01 object is a seed, thought-mode chain, evolved question, and SFT response; collected as an existing promoted Card.

推理数据生成器可以改写文字或整段解法，却很难看见哪些原子变换真正让问题变难。这会造成推理覆盖狭窄、模式重复，以及对前沿难度控制不稳定。

MindLoom 把已验证解法逆向拆成可复用 thought mode，学习哪些模式适合当前问题状态，把稀缺且兼容的模式组合成新问题，并保留 judge 判定正确的解题 rollout。直接产物是一套经过溯源过滤、以明确推理变换为构造单元的 SFT 数据集。

L4 事实：官方来源为 arXiv:2605.21630，年份为 2026；目前仅确认 arXiv 预印本，未确认正式会议；判定边界是来源安全且至少有一次 rollout 被判断正确的合成问题；Track 01 对象是种子、thought-mode 链、演化问题与 SFT 回答组成的记录；该条目是已有并已提升的 Card。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MindLoom represents difficulty as a chain of atomic knowledge-reasoning transformations. A learned retriever proposes modes compatible with the current question, while similarity and scarcity scoring balance semantic fit against overusing common patterns; rollout judging supplies both difficulty labels and correct SFT responses. The mode chain and source ID keep the generation path inspectable.

Open dataset: yes, according to the paper. Name: MindLoom code and dataset release. Official URL: https://github.com/EachSheep/MindLoom. Scale: 58,526 source problems from 16 datasets, 8,322 reverse-engineered records, 11,433 synthesis rollouts, and 9,230 final SFT examples. Record form: source ID, seed question/answer/solution, thought-mode chain, evolved question, rollout response, correctness label, and three-message ms-swift SFT conversion; repository file details should be checked at download time. DeepSeek V3.2 performs reverse engineering, synthesis, rollout, and judging; Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B supports retrieval. License: not confirmed. Intended use: STEM and mathematical SFT.

MindLoom 把难度表示为一串原子知识与推理变换。学习得到的 retriever 提出与当前问题兼容的模式，相似度和稀缺度评分在语义匹配与避免过度使用常见模式之间取平衡；rollout judge 同时提供难度标签和正确 SFT 回答。Thought-mode 链与来源编号使生成路径可以检查。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build a verified reference pool. Input: 58,526 problems from 16 STEM/reasoning datasets with answers and solutions. Operation: run forward inference and retain partial-success cases that have at least one correct trace but are not trivially solved. Output: eligible hard references. Check: all-correct items are too easy and all-wrong items lack a verified trace for reverse analysis.
  2. Reverse-engineer thought modes. Input: an eligible question and verified solution. Operation: DeepSeek V3.2 decomposes the solution into atomic knowledge-reasoning transformations and ordered chains. Output: 8,322 records containing 32,269 mode steps. Check: deduplicate by source ID/question and preserve provenance.
  3. Learn mode retrieval. Input: problem states paired with extracted modes. Operation: fine-tune Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B so a current state retrieves compatible transformations. Output: a thought-mode bank and retriever. Check: compare learned top-20 candidates with random retrieval.
  4. Compose new problems. Input: a seed and retrieved candidates. Operation: choose compatible modes using similarity plus scarcity scoring, then apply up to three evolution steps; stop when a later mode makes the problem incoherent or unsolvable. Output: 7,515 synthesized questions. Check: track selected mode tuple, scores, and source lineage.
  5. Roll out, judge, and filter. Input: each synthesized question. Operation: DeepSeek V3.2 generates three solutions and a strict judge labels correctness; remove records derived from held-out HLE, SciBench, AIME 2025, and excluded MATH-500 questions. Output: 10,854 provenance-safe rollouts and 9,230 final SFT records. Check: keep only questions with at least one judged-correct response.
  6. Run controlled SFT. Input: exactly 9,230 chat-formatted records. Operation: full-parameter SFT for three epochs on Qwen3/Qwen3.5 targets. Output: reasoning models. Check: match data count, hyperparameters, and evaluation protocol for distillation and external-data baselines.

Reproducibility: the paper links one official code/data repository and reports stage counts and defaults. Pin the 16 source snapshots, DeepSeek judge/generator, embedding model, top-20 retrieval, scarcity weight 0.65, three-step policy, provenance exclusions, and SFT conversion; repository license remains unconfirmed.

1. 建立已验证参考池。 输入：来自 16 个 STEM 与推理数据集、带答案和解法的 58,526 道问题。操作：执行前向推理，保留至少有一条正确轨迹但又未被稳定解出的部分成功样本。输出：符合条件的困难参考题。检查：全对题过于简单，全错题没有可用于逆向分析的已验证轨迹。
  2. 逆向提取 thought mode。 输入：符合条件的题目和已验证解法。操作：DeepSeek V3.2 把解法拆成原子知识推理变换及有序链。输出：8,322 条记录，共含 32,269 个模式步骤。检查：按来源编号或题目去重，并保留溯源。
  3. 学习模式检索。 输入：问题状态与提取模式的配对。操作：微调 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B，使当前状态能检索兼容变换。输出：thought-mode 库与 retriever。检查：把学习得到的前 20 个候选与随机检索比较。
  4. 组合新问题。 输入：一道种子题和检索候选。操作：根据相似度与稀缺度评分选择兼容模式，最多执行 3 次演化；后续模式使问题不连贯或不可解时停止。输出：7,515 道合成问题。检查：记录所选模式组合、分数与来源链。
  5. 执行 rollout、判断并过滤。 输入：每道合成问题。操作：DeepSeek V3.2 生成 3 份解答，由严格 judge 标注正确性；删除来源于留出 HLE、SciBench、AIME 2025 及已排除 MATH-500 问题的记录。输出：10,854 条来源安全 rollout 和 9,230 条最终 SFT 记录。检查：只保留至少有一份解答被判断正确的问题。
  6. 执行受控 SFT。 输入：恰好 9,230 条聊天格式记录。操作：在 Qwen3 与 Qwen3.5 目标模型上全参数训练 3 个 epoch。输出：推理模型。检查：蒸馏和外部数据 baseline 必须使用相同数据量、超参数与评测协议。

复现信息：论文链接了一个官方代码与数据仓库，并报告各阶段数量和默认参数。需要固定 16 个来源快照、DeepSeek judge 与生成器、embedding 模型、前 20 检索、0.65 稀缺度权重、三步演化策略、溯源排除项与 SFT 转换；仓库许可仍未确认。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Controlled SFT claim (Table 1). Every fine-tuned baseline uses exactly 9,230 records with identical hyperparameters. On Qwen3.5-9B, MindLoom raises MedQA pass@1 from the base model's 78.71 to 86.80 and reaches the best pass@1 on almost all nine reported benchmarks. This supports the final data pipeline, but the base comparison combines all construction stages.

Filtering claim (Table 2). With the same Qwen3.5-9B setup, removing rollout-based filtering drops MedQA pass@1 from 86.80 to 70.38; the full pipeline also exceeds random retrieval and no reverse engineering across most metrics. The large drop shows that generated-question volume alone is not sufficient and that judged-correct response selection is a central quality gate.

受控 SFT 主张，表 1。 所有微调 baseline 都使用恰好 9,230 条记录和相同超参数。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上，MindLoom 把 MedQA pass@1 从 base model 的 78.71 提高到 86.80，并在论文报告的 9 个 benchmark 中几乎都取得最佳 pass@1。该结果支持最终数据流程，但与 base 的比较包含所有构造阶段。

过滤主张，表 2。 在相同 Qwen3.5-9B 设置下，删除基于 rollout 的过滤会使 MedQA pass@1 从 86.80 降至 70.38；完整流程在大多数指标上也优于随机检索和不做逆向工程。这个明显下降说明只增加生成问题数量并不够，选择 judge 判定正确的回答是核心质量关卡。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior generators mutate whole questions, sample topics, or distill complete teacher trajectories. MindLoom instead reverse-engineers reusable atomic transformations from verified solutions and composes them under learned compatibility and scarcity control. This makes reasoning structure and provenance visible before the final text is produced. Retrieval and rollout filtering are not new separately; the novelty is treating thought modes as compositional data-building units.
以往生成器会改写整道题、采样主题或蒸馏完整教师轨迹。MindLoom 则从已验证解法逆向提取可复用原子变换，并在学习得到的兼容性和稀缺度控制下组合它们，使推理结构与溯源在最终文本生成前就能看见。检索和 rollout 过滤分别都不新，新意在于把 thought mode 当作可组合的数据构造单元。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The method cannot create transformations absent from the 58,526-problem reference corpus, and the final SFT set remains heavily dominated by SuperGPQA provenance.
  • Compatibility, difficulty, and correctness depend on DeepSeek V3.2 generation and LLM judging rather than programmatic verification for every domain.
  • The repository is linked as code/data, but release license and exact artifact completeness were not confirmed; source-dataset rights also remain inherited.

• 该方法无法创造 58,526 道参考题中不存在的变换，而且最终 SFT 数据仍由 SuperGPQA 来源占据较大比例。
  • 兼容性、难度和正确性依赖 DeepSeek V3.2 生成与 LLM 判断，而不是在每个领域都做程序验证。
  • 论文把仓库作为代码与数据链接，但未确认发布许可和产物是否完整；各来源数据集的权利也会继续继承。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use MindLoom when verified solutions are available but whole-problem mutation lacks diversity: extract a mode bank, retrieve compatible transformations, then compose.
  • Preserve source IDs and mode tuples so held-out benchmark lineage can be removed before SFT rather than after evaluation.
  • Audit source dominance, judge disagreement, and mode coverage; add programmatic verifiers where domain answers allow them.

• 当已有已验证解法但整题改写缺少多样性时，可用 MindLoom 提取模式库、检索兼容变换，再进行组合。
  • 应保留来源编号与模式组合，使留出 benchmark 的来源链能在 SFT 前删除，而不是评测后再处理。
  • 应审计来源占比、judge 分歧和模式覆盖；答案允许时还应增加程序 verifier。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: synthesize difficulty by composing reusable transformations extracted from verified solutions.
  • Method handle: partial-success references, reverse engineering, learned retrieval, scarcity-aware composition, rollout judging, provenance filtering.
  • Data/artifact handle: 58,526 references become 9,230 SFT records; the official GitHub is described as code and dataset release.
  • Evidence anchor: Qwen3.5-9B MedQA pass@1 rises 78.71 to 86.80; removing rollout filtering falls to 70.38.
  • Reuse decision: useful for provenance-aware STEM synthesis after checking mode coverage, source balance, judge reliability, and license.

• 一句话定位： 组合从已验证解法提取的可复用变换来合成难度。
  • 方法抓手： 部分成功参考题、逆向工程、学习检索、稀缺度感知组合、rollout 判断、溯源过滤。
  • 数据与产物抓手： 58,526 道参考题最终得到 9,230 条 SFT 记录；论文称官方 GitHub 发布代码与数据。
  • 证据锚点： Qwen3.5-9B 的 MedQA pass@1 从 78.71 提高到 86.80；删除 rollout 过滤后降至 70.38。
  • 复用决定： 适合重视溯源的 STEM 合成，但要检查模式覆盖、来源平衡、judge 可靠性与许可。
